items.title: Meta's social media payout sets precedent for Snap, Google, Roblox — and could be a 'negative'
items.summary: Meta (META) reached a settlement in its social media trial, agreeing to pay up to $16.7 billion, according to Reuters. Bloomberg Intelligence head of technology research Mandeep Singh chats with Yahoo Finance Senior Reporter Brooke DiPalma about the ripple effects of the settlement.

items.title: Meta reaches $16.68 billion settlement in social media case
items.summary: Meta agreed to settle a social media addiction case with a group of state attorneys general on Wednesday, ending the trial in its second week and sending Meta's stock higher.

items.title: Meta Talking With States to Settle Landmark Lawsuit That Claims Facebook and Instagram Were Designed to Be Addictive to Kids: Report
items.summary: Meta Platforms, Inc. (NASDAQ:META) is reportedly in discussions with states to settle its high-profile trial over alleged harm to young social media users. Meta, States Discuss Potential Settlement The Mark Zuckerberg-led tech giant and state attorneys general are discussing a mid-trial settlement while a federal trial is ongoing, Bloomberg reported Tuesday, citing people familiar with the matter. items.title: Changes to Facebook and Instagram are key part of Meta’s $17B settlement with the states over harm to teens
